notifications.title: Set one end screen on each long video
notifications.detail: Guides rate a single, specific next video as the best ending for session watch time. End screens can only be set in YouTube Studio, at upload.
notifications.fix: 1. When uploading a long video, open Editor → End screen. 2. Add one 'Video' element pointing to our closest long video in subject (e.g. 'The 6 levels of money in India' for any rich-vs-poor or which-one-are-you video). 3. Add the Subscribe element. Nothing else.
